plan: An assassin who uses the terrain (water, grass, rocks) to stun a whole team.
aSurveiller: Her R (Supreme Display of Talent). A shockwave that explodes off walls, water and grass and stuns around it: stay away from walls when facing her.
contrer: Stay away from walls and rivers: her R explodes off the terrain.
Stay grouped: she looks for isolated targets.
Use your crowd control after her E: she has no escape left.

sorts.P: First hit on an enemy: bonus damage.
sorts.Q: Strike with an effect based on the element.
sorts.R: Shockwave that explodes off the terrain and stuns.

momentFort: Fragile at levels 1 and 2, dangerous from level 3. She must get ahead early: in the late game she struggles against tanks.
